caption: The drawing depicts a large pitcher with a spout and a single handle, presented in a three-quarter view. The pitcher is primarily decorated in shades of blue, cream, and gold, with intricate detailing along the rim, handle, and base. On the body of the pitcher, there is a painted scene showing a fort or coastal structure on the water, with American flags flying atop the building and along the pier, surrounded by boats, a stone fence, and green landscaping. Above this, below the spout, there is an emblem consisting of a bald eagle with outstretched wings holding a red, white, and blue shield, with green olive branches. Off to the top left of the main pitcher, there is a separate detail showing two American flags crossed, with green branches beneath them, labeled "Under spout on front." To the right, there is a vertical detail of the back of the handle, showing a blue and brown floral or decorative motif, labeled "Back of handle." The background of the drawing is plain and light beige. Handwritten labels give explanatory notes for the decorative elements.
title: Glazed Stone China Pitcher
